name: Luminous Tidepool of a Moonlit Dragonfly
description: A serene tidepool glimmering with bioluminescent light, where delicate moonlit dragonflies hover, casting soft reflections on the water’s surface surrounded by misty cliffs and floating firefly-like specks.
prompt: A luminous tidepool at night, surrounded by dark jagged cliffs, water shimmering with soft blue bioluminescence, dozens of translucent moonlit dragonflies hovering just above the surface, each wing glowing with faint golden halos, gentle ripples, starry sky above, magical atmosphere, hyperrealistic, cinematic lighting.
caption: Dragonflies become the night’s own lanterns 🌙✨ Dive into this twinkling oasis where every flick of a wing paints light on water.
